_readme: Hand-labelled duplicate clusters. Extended by a human, never generated.
A cluster is one opening that was posted more than once. Every fingerprint
listed under `members` is the same seat. Two seats on one team are two
clusters, even when the agency describes them with the same paragraph.
`distinct_pairs` is the other half and it matters just as much: pairs a
human opened, compared, and decided are different. Without them precision
has no honest denominator, because every unlabelled pair is unjudgeable.
Fingerprints come from the live store and are not secret, but the posting
text is. Record fingerprints and a short human note, never the body.
uv run desk resolve --uncertain      # see what the arithmetic could not settle
uv run desk evals --suite dedup      # re-score after editing this file
